meta.facility: Vanguard Cybernetics R&D Facility, Sector 7 (Sub-Levels 1 to 4)
meta.target_asset: HSM Unit 09-Alpha (Hardware Security Module, Enterprise Cryptographic Key Vault)

evidence.description: RFID Badge EMP-8842 (Dr. Aris Thorne) scanned at Sector 7 R&D floor main turnstile.
evidence.anomaly_note: Log entry insertion time differs from network epoch timestamp by 142 seconds.

evidence.description: Camera CAM-7B captures an individual wearing Dr. Thorne's coat and lab badge entering the Lab 3 door keyway.
evidence.anomaly_note: Facial height to shoulder ratio does not match Dr. Thorne's biometric profile.

evidence.description: Vault 9-Alpha opened using Master Override Code 55-Delta, assigned to Marcus Vance.
evidence.anomaly_note: Physical vault latch sensors trigger a physical removal flag.

evidence.description: Dr. Aris Thorne's authenticated mobile smartphone registered on Metro Tower 4 Cell Tower, 3.2 miles from the facility.
evidence.anomaly_note: Proves physical badge EMP-8842 was cloned or used by a proxy.

evidence.description: Camera CAM-2A captures Dr. Thorne's badge holder purchasing coffee at the facility cafeteria (Ground Floor).
evidence.anomaly_note: Physically impossible to travel from Lab 3 (Sub-level 2) to the Cafeteria (Ground Floor) in 3 minutes.

evidence.description: Physical retinal scanner at the Lab 3 rear emergency airlock logged a scan from Elena Rostova.
evidence.anomaly_note: Directly contradicts Elena Rostova's statement of never entering the restricted R&D floor after 18:00.

evidence.description: Internal IDS alert reporting a foreign payload attempting a memory dump of HSM 09-Alpha via a zero-day SSH vulnerability.
evidence.anomaly_note: Source IP traced back to Marcus Vance's compromised internal maintenance tap.

evidence.description: Encrypted message sent to the security hotline stating that Thorne sold the cryptographic root keys to foreign buyers at 20:00.
evidence.anomaly_note: Fabricated tip sent to frame Dr. Thorne and divert attention from the active breach.

evidence.description: Air gapped safe deposit enclosure activated in Elena Rostova's secure subterranean workspace (B-4 Vault).
evidence.anomaly_note: Confirms physical relocation of the HSM into emergency offline containment.

evidence.description: Security alert reporting that access logs were purged from 19:00 to 22:00 via an SQL injection attack launched from an internal security terminal.
evidence.anomaly_note: Database wipe attempt executed using administrator rights belonging to Kaelen Voss.

evidence.description: A junior technician states seeing Marcus Vance hand an encrypted USB flash drive to an unidentified individual near elevator shaft 3.
evidence.anomaly_note: Indicates physical collusion and unauthorized tool deployment by Vance.

evidence.description: Database query audit log showing user "kvoss" executed a manual update script targeting timestamp indices for RFID reader 7B.
evidence.anomaly_note: Proves Kaelen Voss directly tampered with RFID logs to fabricate Thorne's entry record.

evidence.description: System alert reporting HSM 09-Alpha heartbeat loss detected on the primary rack position.
evidence.anomaly_note: Triggers the original automated theft alert despite the unit being moved to the offline vault.

evidence.description: Camera CAM-12 (Server Room B) shows Kaelen Voss logged into the administrative console during his claimed maintenance window.
evidence.anomaly_note: Verifies Voss's physical presence at the control console during database record manipulation.

evidence.description: Encrypted email to the facility director claiming Elena Rostova was seen carrying a heavy metallic briefcase out to the main parking lot.
evidence.anomaly_note: Disproved by B-4 vault telemetry showing the HSM unit remained secured inside sub-basement 4.

suspects.name: Dr. Aris Thorne
suspects.statement: I completed my shift at 19:30, handed over the calibration log, and left the building at 20:00. I was at the Downtown Bistro by 20:30 and stayed there until midnight. I never authorized any HSM extraction.
suspects.secret_motive: Illicit IP extraction of low-level cipher specs for an external buyer, unrelated to the physical HSM unit.

suspects.name: Elena Rostova
suspects.role: Senior Infrastructure and Cyber Defense Officer
suspects.statement: I never entered the restricted R&D floor after 18:00. When the alarm sounded at 22:47, I was working remotely from home via encrypted VPN.
suspects.secret_motive: Initiated an emergency offline extraction protocol to preserve HSM keys from an active, undetectable zero-day exploit.

suspects.name: Marcus Vance
suspects.role: Facilities and Physical Security Operations Chief
suspects.statement: I performed a standard sweep of Sector 7 at 21:00. All doors were secured, and the HSM vault intact. I did not touch the access control database.
suspects.secret_motive: Hiding physical maintenance breaches and accepting bribes to allow an unauthorized rogue hardware tap on the facility spine.

suspects.name: Kaelen Voss
suspects.role: Lead System Architect and Database Administrator
suspects.statement: I was performing scheduled system maintenance on the main database server from 20:00 to 22:30 in server room B. Any log discrepancies are due to a scheduled epoch syncing routine.
suspects.secret_motive: Exploited database access to alter access logs and sell badge-cloning software to corporate espionage groups.

contradictions.title: Impossible Gap 1
contradictions.conflict: Badge EMP-8842 scanned inside Sub-level 2, Vault 9-Alpha vs Badge EMP-8842 at Ground Floor Cafeteria terminal.
contradictions.gap_or_difference: Minimum 12 minutes through 3 biometrically gated airlocks required; only 3 minutes elapsed.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Cafeteria scanner spoofed/cloned; log inserted by Kaelen Voss to frame Dr. Thorne.

contradictions.title: Impossible Gap 2
contradictions.conflict: Badge EMP-8842 logged at Sector 7 turnstile vs Thorne's phone on Metro Tower 4, 3.2 miles away.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Badge EMP-8842 was cloned; Dr. Thorne was not present on campus.

contradictions.title: Statement vs evidence
contradictions.conflict: Rostova: never entered R&D floor after 18:00 vs retinal scan at Lab 3 rear airlock 19:53:12.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Rostova's statement is false on this point (Genuine biometric, 0.88).

contradictions.title: Dataset internal mismatch
contradictions.conflict: Gap 1 describes Thorne's badge scanned in Vault 9-Alpha; EVI 003 shows the vault opened by Vance's Master Override Code 55-Delta, not Thorne's badge.
contradictions.gap_or_difference: Source description differs between Gap 1 and EVI 003.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Treat EVI 003 (the evidence item) as authoritative; flag the wording difference.

contradictions.title: Dataset internal mismatch
contradictions.conflict: Gap 1 resolution says a cafeteria RFID log was inserted by Voss; EVI 005 is a CCTV Feed item (status Completely Misleading), not an RFID log.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Report both: case file attributes the cafeteria record to Voss; direct proof for CCTV manipulation is not itemised.

contradictions.title: Statement vs evidence
contradictions.conflict: Thorne says he was in the building until 20:00 vs EVI 004 places his phone 3.2 miles off-site at 19:42.
contradictions.gap_or_difference: Thorne's own timeline is inconsistent with telemetry.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Telemetry (0.95) favoured; Thorne is not the thief per case file, but his statement is not fully accurate (secret motive: unrelated IP extraction). Do not assert more than this.

contradictions.title: Statement vs evidence
contradictions.conflict: Voss claims maintenance 20:00-22:30 vs EVI 014 shows him at the admin console at 19:48 (before window) and EVI 012 shows his account running the tamper script at 23:10 (after window).
contradictions.gap_or_difference: Activity falls outside his stated window on both sides.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Weakens Voss's 'scheduled maintenance / epoch sync' explanation; EVI 001 offset (142 s) is localised to RFID reader 7B edits.

contradictions.title: Statement vs evidence
contradictions.conflict: Vance says he only swept Sector 7 at 21:00 and did not touch access control vs EVI 003 (his override code used 19:54), EVI 011 (USB handoff 20:10, witness 0.55), EVI 007 (attack traced to his tap).
contradictions.gap_or_difference: Code use, tap and USB handoff are not covered by his statement.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Code use alone does not prove he was present (case file: he did not physically extract the HSM). EVI 011 is low-reliability corroboration only.

contradictions.title: Time-window mismatch
contradictions.conflict: Problem statement window is 19:30-22:30, but alarm (22:47), audit log (23:10) and purge alert (23:15) fall after it.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Real theft/relocation (19:53-19:55) is inside the window; the alarm and cover-up are later consequences.

contradictions.title: Unexplained gap
contradictions.conflict: HSM moved offline at 19:55 (EVI 009) but heartbeat-loss alert only fires at 22:47 (EVI 013).
contradictions.gap_or_difference: 2 h 52 min between relocation and alert.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Not explained by the case file; report as an open question. Do not invent a cause.

contradictions.title: Unexplained gap
contradictions.conflict: Rostova's motive is pre-empting a zero-day, yet the IDS memory-dump alert (EVI 007) is logged at 22:30, 2 h 35 min after the HSM was already offline.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Case file calls the exploit 'undetectable'; consistent only if the attack was active earlier. Report as inference, not proven fact.

contradictions.title: Data integrity
contradictions.conflict: EVI 010 says access logs 19:00-22:00 were purged, yet entries from this period (e.g., EVI 001 at 19:42) still exist.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Surviving entries in this window must be treated with caution; EVI 010 itself is Altered (0.45).

contradictions.title: Reliability vs truth
contradictions.conflict: CCTV has weight 0.85 yet EVI 002 is Altered and EVI 005 is Completely Misleading.
contradictions.gap_or_difference: High source weight does not imply a true record.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Status and anomaly note override source weight.

contradictions.title: Confidence figure
contradictions.conflict: Case file states 89.2% confidence for Option C; simple mean of the five chain items' reliability scores is 93.6%.
contradictions.resolution_or_handling: Quote 89.2% as 'stated in the case file'; do not present a self-computed value as the official one. Both exceed the 0.85 threshold.

verdict_options.claim: Dr. Aris Thorne physically stole the HSM to sell cryptographic keys.
verdict_options.flaw: Disproved by cell tower telemetry, gait analysis mismatch, and tampered database logs.

verdict_options.claim: Marcus Vance manipulated the security database and directly stole the HSM.
verdict_options.flaw: Vance provided network access via a compromised hardware tap, but did not move or extract the physical HSM.

verdict_options.claim: Elena Rostova executed an unauthorized emergency extraction of the HSM to prevent exfiltration via a zero-day exploit, enabled by Marcus Vance's compromised network tap. Meanwhile, Kaelen Voss tampered with database logs and badge data to frame Dr. Thorne and obscure the breach.
Kaelen Voss stole the HSM while remote-wiping the security database.
verdict_options.flaw: Voss manipulated database logs to assist the cover-up and frame Thorne, but never physically accessed Vault 9-Alpha or handled the HSM unit.
